_comment: Single source of truth for GSF citation metadata. Consumed by the GSF
Explorer (webapp/main.js fetches this file) and by the documentation
(mkdocs_hooks/citations.py renders it into the Home page and the model
version table at mkdocs build time). Edit here, nowhere else.
BibTeX blocks are InspireHEP records, verbatim (fetched 2026-07-30;
recommended_note: Please cite the GSF 2026 paper (arXiv:2609.32649) together with the software version you used.

solar_modulation_potentials.label: Ghelfi–Maurin–Derome (GMD) φ(t)
solar_modulation_potentials.note: Neutron monitors and muon detectors for solar modulation studies: 2. φ time series. The GSF 2026 default; each current set ships its own monthly table as data/<version>/solar_modulation.dat.

solar_modulation_potentials.label: Usoskin et al. 2017 φ(t)
solar_modulation_potentials.note: Heliospheric modulation of cosmic rays during the neutron monitor era. Used by the 2026.1-USO variant and by the historical sets; bundled at the package data root as solar_modulation.dat.
